Every public type in the Latiprimere packages, with its members, generated from the documentation comments in the source. The [guides](/docs/guides/print-options-and-jobs/) show how they fit together.

Most types are in the `Latiprimere` namespace, whichever package they come from. Each package's methods for dependency injection, such as `AddLatiprimereIpp()`, are in `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection`.

## Latiprimere.Abstractions

The interfaces, records, enums and exceptions every package shares, in the `Latiprimere` namespace. It comes with the other packages, so you don't install it yourself.

- [ColorMode](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/colormode/): Enumerates the ways a printer can render colour.
- [DocumentFormat](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/documentformat/): Enumerates the document formats that can be submitted to a printer.
- [DuplexMode](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/duplexmode/): Enumerates the ways pages can be printed on one or both sides of the paper.
- [Finishing](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/finishing/): Something a printer does to the printed sheets: staples, holes or a fold.
- [IdentifyAction](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/identifyaction/): Enumerates the ways a printer can make itself known when asked to with [IPrinter.IdentifyAsync](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#identifyasync), as IPP's `identify-actions` has them.
- [InputTray](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/inputtray/): A paper source on a printer, such as a tray or the manual feed.
- [IPdfRasterizer](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/ipdfrasterizer/): Turns PDF documents into pixels, for print systems that need images rather than PDF, such as the Windows spooler.
- [IPrinter](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/): A printer that can accept print jobs.
- [IPrinterCatalog](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintercatalog/): Finds the printers available to the application.
- [IPrintJob](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintjob/): A job that has been submitted to a printer.
- [IPrintSystem](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintsystem/): A platform print system, such as the Windows spooler or CUPS, implemented by a Latiprimere platform adapter.
- [IRasterDocument](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/irasterdocument/): An opened document whose pages can be rendered to pixels, one horizontal band at a time.
- [MediaSize](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/mediasize/): A paper size a printer can print on.
- [MediaSizeRange](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/mediasizerange/): The sizes of paper a printer takes beyond its listed sizes: custom sheets, or lengths cut from a roll, such as a receipt or label printer's.
- [MediaType](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/mediatype/): A kind of paper or other medium to print on, such as plain paper, labels or glossy photo paper, as the printer reports it.
- [OutputBin](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/outputbin/): Where a printer delivers the printed sheets, such as its top tray or a mailbox, as the printer reports it.
- [PageOrientation](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/pageorientation/): Enumerates the orientations in which pages can be printed.
- [PageRange](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/pagerange/): A run of pages to print, counted from 1, both ends included, as [PrintOptions.PageRanges](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#pageranges) takes them. One page is a range whose first and last are the same: `new PageRange(3, 3)`.
- [PageSize](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/pagesize/): The size of a document page.
- [PdfOpenOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/pdfopenoptions/): Describes how a PDF is opened for rasterising.
- [PrintAuthenticationException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printauthenticationexception/): The exception thrown when a print system needs a user name and password for a request, or doesn't accept the ones it was given.
- [PrintCertificateException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printcertificateexception/): The exception thrown when a printer's certificate isn't trusted, so no encrypted connection to it was made.
- [PrintContent](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printcontent/): Represents a document to be printed: its data and its format.
- [PrinterCapabilities](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printercapabilities/): What a printer can do, as reported by its print system.
- [PrinterDetails](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printerdetails/): What a printer reports about itself beyond printing: its web pages, pictures of it, its firmware, and how it can be identified.
- [PrinterFirmware](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printerfirmware/): A part of a printer's firmware and its version, as the printer reports them.
- [PrinterInfo](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printerinfo/): Describes a printer known to a print system.
- [PrinterNotFoundException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printernotfoundexception/): The exception thrown when a requested printer does not exist.
- [PrinterState](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printerstate/): Enumerates the states a printer can report.
- [PrinterStatus](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printerstatus/): Describes a printer's state at a point in time.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The exception thrown when a printing operation fails. Base class for all Latiprimere exceptions.
- [PrintJobState](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printjobstate/): Enumerates the states a print job can be in. Modelled on the IPP job states.
- [PrintJobStatus](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printjobstatus/): Describes the status of a print job at a point in time.
- [PrintOptionKinds](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptionkinds/): The settings of [PrintOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/), as flags, for saying which of them a printer applies ([IPrinter.AppliedOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#appliedoptions)).
- [PrintOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/): Describes how a print job should be printed.
- [PrintQuality](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printquality/): How carefully to print, trading speed and ink for detail, as IPP's `print-quality` has it.
- [PrintSystemUnavailableException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printsystemunavailableexception/): The exception thrown when a print system can't be used: no supported print system is available on the current platform, usually because no Latiprimere platform adapter has been registered for it, or a print system's own service isn't running, such as the Windows Print Spooler.
- [RasterBand](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/rasterband/): Describes one horizontal band of a page rendered at a given pixel size.
- [RasterPixelFormat](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/rasterpixelformat/): How a rendered band's pixels are laid out in memory.
- [RasterRenderOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/rasterrenderoptions/): Describes how a band is rendered, beyond its size, pixel format and rotation.
- [RasterRotation](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/rasterrotation/): How far to turn a page as it is rendered, clockwise, in quarter turns.
- [ScalingMode](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/scalingmode/): Enumerates the ways an image is sized on the paper, as IPP's `print-scaling` has them.
- [VendorOption](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroption/): A setting a printer offers beyond the typed options in [PrintOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/), such as print quality, stapling or a driver's own settings, with the values it takes.
- [VendorOptionChoice](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroptionchoice/): One of the values a [VendorOption](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroption/) can be set to.
- [VendorOptionKind](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroptionkind/): What kind of value a [VendorOption](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroption/) takes.

## Latiprimere

The printer catalog, which brings the print systems together, and following a job's status.

- [LatiprimereServiceCollectionExtensions](/docs/reference/latiprimere/latiprimereservicecollectionextensions/): Registers Latiprimere services with a dependency injection container.
- [PrinterCatalog](/docs/reference/latiprimere/printercatalog/): Finds printers across every print system supported on the current platform.
- [PrinterExtensions](/docs/reference/latiprimere/printerextensions/): Provides helper methods for following printers.
- [PrintJobExtensions](/docs/reference/latiprimere/printjobextensions/): Provides helper methods for following print jobs.

## Latiprimere.Ipp

Printing straight to network printers over IPP and IPPS, on every platform.

- [IppNetworkOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/): Configures printing directly to IPP network printers, without CUPS or the Windows spooler.
- [IppNetworkPrintSystemFactory](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkprintsystemfactory/): Creates the IPP network print system, for applications that don't use dependency injection.
- [IppRasterFormat](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ipprasterformat/): The raster formats Latiprimere can render a PDF into for a printer that can't take PDF, for [IppNetworkOptions.RasterFormats](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#rasterformats).
- [LatiprimereIppServiceCollectionExtensions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/latiprimereippservicecollectionextensions/): Registers the IPP network print system with a dependency injection container.

## Latiprimere.Cups

Printing through CUPS: the local scheduler on Linux and macOS, or a CUPS server.

- [CupsEncryption](/docs/reference/latiprimere-cups/cupsencryption/): Enumerates when requests to a CUPS server travel over an encrypted (TLS) connection.
- [CupsOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-cups/cupsoptions/): Configures how Latiprimere connects to CUPS.
- [CupsPrintSystemFactory](/docs/reference/latiprimere-cups/cupsprintsystemfactory/): Creates the CUPS print system, for applications that don't use dependency injection.
- [LatiprimereCupsServiceCollectionExtensions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-cups/latiprimerecupsservicecollectionextensions/): Registers the CUPS print system with a dependency injection container.

## Latiprimere.Windows

Printing through the Windows spooler and its drivers.

- [IWindowsPrinter](/docs/reference/latiprimere-windows/iwindowsprinter/): A printer managed by the Windows spooler, with what only Windows offers: its driver's Print Capabilities and Print Tickets.
- [LatiprimereWindowsServiceCollectionExtensions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-windows/latiprimerewindowsservicecollectionextensions/): Registers the Windows print system with a dependency injection container.
- [WindowsOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-windows/windowsoptions/): Configures printing through the Windows print spooler.
- [WindowsPrintSystemFactory](/docs/reference/latiprimere-windows/windowsprintsystemfactory/): Creates the Windows print system, for applications that don't use dependency injection.

## Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium

Rendering PDFs with PDFium, for Windows drivers and for network printers that can't take PDF.

- [LatiprimerePdfiumServiceCollectionExtensions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-rendering-pdfium/latiprimerepdfiumservicecollectionextensions/): Registers the PDFium rasteriser with a dependency injection container.
- [PdfiumOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-rendering-pdfium/pdfiumoptions/): Limits on the PDFs [PdfiumRasterizer](/docs/reference/latiprimere-rendering-pdfium/pdfiumrasterizer/) opens and renders, for applications that print PDFs from anyone, such as a web application's users.
- [PdfiumRasterizer](/docs/reference/latiprimere-rendering-pdfium/pdfiumrasterizer/): Rasterises PDF documents with PDFium.
